log.token_rejected: Gateway rejected the access token; returning to pairing
log.decode_failed: Couldn't read the gateway's {type} response (app and gateway versions may differ): {error} body={body}
log.crash_report: Crash report from an earlier run saved to {file}: {summary}
log.diagnostic_report: Diagnostic report from an earlier run saved to {file}
log.log_rolled: Log passed {bytes} bytes today; earlier lines are in {file}
log.logs_loaded: Logs screen: {gateway} gateway + {device} device lines, clock difference {skew}s
log.logs_failed: Logs screen: couldn't load the gateway log: {error}
log.logs_clock: Device clock is {skew}s off the gateway's (device {device_tz}, gateway {gateway_tz})

errors.add_unreached: Couldn't reach the gateway. It may not have been added; tap + to try again.
errors.dns: Can't find the gateway host. On Tailscale, make sure the VPN is connected.
errors.unreachable: Can't reach the gateway. Is the container running and the port open?
errors.tls: The secure connection to the gateway failed. Use http:// for a Tailscale 100.x address, or check the certificate if you serve it over HTTPS.
errors.ats: iOS blocked a plain HTTP connection. The app allows HTTP by default; check Info.plist NSAppTransportSecurity.
errors.decoding: The gateway answered in a format this app doesn't understand. The app and gateway are probably different versions: update both. Settings → Troubleshooting → Share debug report has the details.

logs.title: Logs
logs.clock_warn: This iPhone's clock is {seconds} s off the gateway's, so the two sides won't line up. Settings → General → Date & Time → Set Automatically.
logs.truncated: Older gateway lines are in the debug report.
logs.note: Times are UTC on both sides. Tap a request id to see that call in both logs. API keys and the access token are removed.
